description: Solar Energy Harvesting Dataset (2023–2025) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors John Amanesi Abubakar, Jens Dede (University of Bologna). This dataset contains over 2.5 million real-world measurements collected from a photovoltaic (PV) inverter system between 2023 and 2025. The data were recorded as part of research on solar energy forecasting, energy-aware intermittent computing, and predictive checkpointing for IoT nodes. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
